scenarios.text: A raider's mortar shell lands one cell from a colonist manning a sandbag line. The colonist sails about three cells away from the impact, clean over the sandbags, lands, lies stunned for a moment and is still alive.
scenarios.expect: accept: a mortar beside a colonist throws them about three cells over sandbags, alive and briefly stunned

scenarios.text: A mortar shell hits right beside a colonist crouched behind sandbags. The colonist lurches toward the sandbag line and stops against it, staying on the near side while dust settles.
scenarios.expect: reject: the throw must carry over sandbags and barricades, not stop at them

scenarios.text: A grenade goes off beside a colonist in a narrow corridor. They fly into the stone wall, take a hit, and then bounce back off it two cells the way they came before landing.
scenarios.expect: reject: a thrown person stops dead at a wall; people never rebound

scenarios.text: A modded launcher's own setting is a strong throw, but the shell it fires has its throw set to zero. When the shell explodes among raiders, they take blast damage but none of them is moved.
scenarios.expect: accept: the projectile's tuning wins over the weapon's, and zero turns the throw off

scenarios.text: A modded grenade is tuned with its own maximum throw of two cells. Thrown at a cluster of raiders, it hurls one of them five cells across the yard.
scenarios.expect: reject: a weapon's own maximum caps its throw

scenarios.text: A modded charge with an impact factor of zero goes off beside a raider standing by a closed wooden door. The raider flies into the door and stops, and afterwards neither the raider nor the door has any new damage from the collision.
scenarios.expect: accept: an impact factor of 0 makes throws hit walls, pawns and doors harmlessly, the door undamaged

scenarios.text: A grav-ram whose own body-size limit is 3.6 strikes near a wild animal of body size 3. The animal is lifted and thrown several cells before it lands stunned.
scenarios.expect: accept: a weapon's own body-size limit lets it throw pawns under that limit, bigger than the global one

scenarios.text: With Mod Settings left at their defaults, an ordinary frag grenade goes off beside a body size 3 animal. The animal is thrown three cells across the field.
scenarios.expect: reject: by the 2.5 body-size default, a pawn of body size 2.5 or more is never thrown by a weapon without its own limit

scenarios.text: A mortar lands in a workshop beside a 120 kg stack of steel blocks, with the mass limit left at the default. The stack lifts off and tumbles across the room.
scenarios.expect: reject: goods heavier than 75 kg (the Mod Settings mass limit) are never thrown

scenarios.text: A frag grenade kills a raider standing in a storeroom. His corpse spins up in a high arc with the loose goods around it, bounces off the back wall noticeably slower each time, and comes to rest.
scenarios.expect: accept: loose goods and corpses, including a pawn the blast kills, fly wild in a high arc with spin and rebounds that lose energy

scenarios.text: A mortar lands in the stockpile. The stacks of medicine and components slide away along the floor in straight lines, never leaving the ground or turning, and stop where they slow.
scenarios.expect: reject: goods must fly in a high arc, spinning fast and rebounding off walls

scenarios.text: A grenade goes off beside a raider standing at the edge of an open pit. He is thrown toward it and drops down onto the pit floor.
scenarios.expect: accept: anything thrown toward an open pit falls to its floor

scenarios.text: A mortar blast throws a raider toward an open pit. He arcs over the pit and lands on the far rim, unhurt by any fall.
scenarios.expect: reject: nothing is thrown across a pit; it falls to the floor

scenarios.text: A colonist hauling wood takes her usual route through the yard, steps onto a covered pit cell and falls through. No explosion or other force was involved.
scenarios.expect: reject: no colonist walks into a pit by ordinary pathing

scenarios.text: A raider tosses a smoke grenade that bursts on top of a covered pit with another raider standing on it. The cover shatters and the raider standing on it drops in.
scenarios.expect: reject: a smoke or stun burst never breaks a pit cover

scenarios.text: An incendiary blast goes off among raiders beside a frag grenade's earlier blast. The incendiary throws people noticeably shorter, about half as far as the frag did at the same distance.
scenarios.expect: accept: every harmful explosion throws, fire at half

scenarios.text: A flammable gas cloud drifting through a storeroom catches fire. It pops in a run of small bursts following the flames; goods near each burst scatter, and a colonist inside is pushed one cell and is not hurt.
scenarios.expect: accept: a lit flammable gas cloud goes off clump by clump, scattering goods and shoving people one cell unhurt

scenarios.text: A long flammable gas cloud over a storage yard is lit at one end. The whole cloud goes off at once as one big blast from its middle, throwing everything outward from that single point.
scenarios.expect: reject: gas goes off clump by clump, never one centroid blast

scenarios.text: A colonist wearing a charged shield belt is standing inside a flammable gas cloud when it catches. Their shield flickers as the burst nearest them goes off, and they stay on their cell while goods around them scatter.
scenarios.expect: reject: the gas burst shoves a pawn one cell and a shield belt does not stop the shove

scenarios.text: A grenade bursts next to a raider with a full shield belt. The belt flashes and absorbs it, the raider stays where he stood, and his belt's charge drops more than an ordinary hit of that size would take.
scenarios.expect: accept: a shield belt that absorbs the blast keeps its wearer in place and pays extra charge

scenarios.text: A mortar lands beside a small crate full of medicine in the storeroom. The crate jolts and shifts one cell, and when the player opens it all the medicine is still inside.
scenarios.expect: accept: closed containers keep their goods and may themselves be shoved a little

scenarios.text: A grenade goes off beside a locker holding weapons. The locker bursts open and the weapons are flung across the room with the floor goods.
scenarios.expect: reject: closed containers keep their goods

scenarios.text: A mortar lands in a storeroom lined with open shelves. The loose stacks on the floor fly, but every stack on the shelves stays exactly where it was.
scenarios.expect: reject: open shelves, racks and tables protect nothing

scenarios.text: The player halves the throw strength line in Mod Settings and saves. The next grenade at the same distance throws a colonist just as far as before.
scenarios.expect: reject: every Mod Settings line takes effect; strength scales the throw

scenarios.text: A grenade lands between two raiders and throws both toward the same spot behind a crate. The first lands on the cell it was thrown at; the second, seeing that cell now taken, curves mid-air and settles neatly on the free cell beside it. Both shake off the stun and carry on.
scenarios.expect: reject: a thrown pawn lands on the cell chosen at the blast and is never re-targeted mid-flight

scenarios.text: A mortar shell lands in the middle of a big, crowded stockpile. Dozens of light stacks around the crater fly up and scatter across the room. Near the far edge of the blast, where each stack would still be thrown two or three cells, five or six stacks of cloth and herbal medicine sit exactly where they were.
scenarios.expect: reject: every light loose good the blast reaches with a throw of a cell or more moves; no cap skips the far stacks

scenarios.text: A grenade bursts in a cluttered storeroom. The stacks right beside it arc up and tumble across the room, while a few stacks further out blink off their cells and pop up a few cells away under a little puff of dust. Everything ends up scattered and nothing is lost.
scenarios.expect: reject: goods never vanish and reappear under a dust puff; the hop is what was rejected

scenarios.text: A frag grenade goes off in a narrow stone storeroom. The components and steel arc up high, spinning fast, and smack into the back wall. There they drop straight to the floor at the foot of the wall and stay.
scenarios.expect: reject: goods rebound off walls keeping about 70 percent of their speed until spent, not stop at the first wall

scenarios.text: A mortar lands in a storeroom lined with open shelves. The floor stacks fly, and the shelves rattle; two stacks near the crater tumble off, but the rest of each shelf stays loaded and neatly in place.
scenarios.expect: reject: open shelves protect nothing; the shelves should be emptied like the floor

scenarios.text: A grenade by the storeroom door throws a stack of steel toward a covered pit trap. The stack arcs over and lands on the cover, sliding to a stop on top of it. The cover holds and the steel sits there waiting to be hauled.
scenarios.expect: reject: anything thrown onto a covered pit cell falls through and breaks the cover

scenarios.text: A flammable gas cloud in the hallway catches, and small bursts ripple through it clump by clump as the fire advances, flicking nearby goods a cell or two each. A colonist inside the cloud is shoved one cell by a burst and comes away with a few bruises and a minor burn from the blast.
scenarios.expect: reject: the gas shove moves a pawn one cell without hurting them; blast damage fails it

scenarios.text: A grenade lands beside a small medicine crate that sits on the rim of an open pit. The crate keeps every packet inside, and the blast shoves it a cell, sliding it over the rim and down onto the pit floor.
scenarios.expect: reject: a closed container keeps its goods but never slides into a pit, a wall or onto a pawn

scenarios.text: A mortar lands in a storeroom beside a small locker pushed hard against the stone wall. The locker cannot slide back, so it just jolts sharply in place, and every weapon stays inside it while the loose stacks around it fly.
scenarios.expect: accept: closed containers keep their goods and may be shoved a little; with the cell behind blocked it jolts in place

scenarios.text: A grenade goes off in a stockpile; the stacks near it fly, spinning off the walls. A single wood stack at the very rim of the blast, where the throw would come to less than one cell, stays put while everything nearer moves.
scenarios.expect: accept: a thing at the rim whose throw is under one cell is spared; only throws of a cell or more must move
